verdict.rationale: Undermind's own marketing claims ongoing alerting: "Get notified whenever relevant papers are published" on the main site, and enterprise "Role-aware alerts" that monitor saved topics and send updates. That is a recurring standing search, not a one-off rerun. missing for 10: detailed docs on how alerts are set up (frequency, delivery channel, alert criteria), any hands-on or community confirmation that alerts work, and clarity on whether role-aware alerts are enterprise-only.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can set up standing searches or alerts that surface new relevant sources as they appear

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Role-aware alerts: Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
